raw_definitions: Definisi : vt 1. plunder and destroy, memporak-perandakan: the pirates harried the western coast of the island, lanun-lanun memporak-perandakan pantai barat pulau itu; 2. harass, sering mengganggu: she was harried by reporters once they knew about her involvement with the prince, dia sering diganggu oleh wartawan apabila mereka tahu akan keterlibatannya dgn putera raja itu. (Kamus Inggeris-Melayu Dewan)
